name: The Fields [UPDATE]
desc:
30-09-2026
v0.4.1 - Fresh Coat of Paint

"Life rots quickest where it grows fastest."

Months have passed since HEMCOR sealed off The [REDACTED] Fields. The news won't stop circling the story, speaking only of HEMCOR and their explanations as “irregularities in agricultural life” and the need for “further study.”

But you don't trust them.
And for reasons that are known only to you, you step into the quarantine zone.

M - View controls (PC)

This game is in early access, expect a few bugs.
EVERYTHING IN THE GAME IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE.

The Fields is inspired by @Octik's "TRAVERSAL", Acid Wizard Studio's "Darkwood", and Badorkbee's "Isle".
